content: चैत्रः [चि ष्ट्रण्; चित्रमेव स्वार्थे अण्; चित्रायां भवः अण् वा] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a lunar month in which the full moon stands in the constellation Chitrā (corresponding to March-April). .²2 A Buddhist mendicant. .²3 One of the seven ranges of mountains dividing the continent into Varṣas. .{@-त्रम्@} A temple, monument for the dead.
